description: A warm, calm man in his forties with a gentle, resonant baritone voice. He is a native Polish speaker with a natural standard Polish accent. He prays aloud sincerely at a natural, unhurried conversational pace, with natural intonation, reverent but not slow and not theatrical.
ref_text: Chwała Ojcu i Synowi, i Duchowi Świętemu. Jak była na początku, teraz i zawsze, i na wieki wieków. Amen.
